title: Add a second voice under an existing one

args.content:
m3 v2 | G4:h F4:h
m4 v2 | _:h D4:h

all.contains: m3 v1 | E5:q D5:q C5:q A4:q
m4 v1 | D5:q F5:q G5:q B4:q

questions: How a gap at the start of voice 2 is printed after the write: assumed `_:h` (NOTATION.md 4); MuseScore stores no rest there, so the printer may print nothing for that time.
Voice out of 1-4: the input schema has min/max, so the server may reject it as E_INVALID_ARG (schema) rather than E_RANGE (notes.md).

Settled 2026-10-29 (P2.3): write_voice takes staff (1-based) and content as voice lines 'm<N> v<V> | ...' exactly as score_read prints them; validation problems are E_INVALID_ARG naming the bar and voice; an unknown staff is E_RANGE.
